enhanced_indexing.reason: Factor exposures and benchmark absent; no invented factors

SHRINK_OAS.reason: Installed Qlib 0.9.7 formula differs from its documented OAS formula and independent reference. No dependency patch or replacement estimator.

mathematical_conventions.bounds: Absolute full-NAV weights; cash fixed; long only; no automatic subset/cardinality optimizer
mathematical_conventions.covariance: ddof1 sample scale; Qlib shrinkage ddof0 scaled by T/(T-1); const_var target; no NaN handling/fill needed or allowed
mathematical_conventions.risk_analysis: Explicit periods_per_year and note; Qlib sum mode; linear annualization and zero-reference information ratio, not CAGR or Sharpe
mathematical_conventions.risk_parity: Equal component variance contributions; verify achieved equality; reject incompatible constraints
mathematical_conventions.risk_parity_positive_domain: Normalized weights >=1e-12. Warm start must have positive marginal variances; inverse volatility when admissible, otherwise Phase-I linear feasibility with existing SciPy. Qlib RP objective and final equal-contribution check unchanged.

numerical_policy: Pinned Qlib objectives; minimal subclass adds bounds and fail-closed SciPy SLSQP status/KKT/RC checks. No fallback allocations. Analytic equality/GMV/MVO derivatives; existing 1e-12 PRISM accounting tolerance preserved. Runtime verification of pinned Qlib source hashes is repeated on every adapter verification; only optimizer class construction is cached.

performance_attribution.reason: Missing underlying instrument positions/amounts, benchmark weights/returns and sector classification
